QuestInfo.name: Ericsson Loves Cats
QuestInfo.1: Ericsson wants to give Nero a very special gift. Ask Elma to make #t4031199# for Nero.
QuestInfo.2: I got the Lunar Wristband for Ericsson's beloved kitty, Nero.

0.0: I want to give a very special gift to my darling kitty, Nero. I really need your help with this.
0.1: Brewing the Sap of Nependeath is so tedious! I need to take a break and spend some time with my cat. Nero gets fussy if he doesn't get his afternoon play session in.
0.2: You really want to give the Nependeath Juice to Alfonse?

yes.0: Nero just loves sparkly things. Something like a #i4031199#... man, he goes bananas! Actually, do you think you could get one from #bElma#k? I think he'd really like it.

no.0: If you aren't going to help me, why are you even here? I need to play with my kitty cat, anyway.

1.0: Nero is going to loooove this! He will be THE most handsome cat. You're such a little handsome kitty, yes you are!

item.0: Nero seems to love #b#t4031199##k a lot. I'd really appreciate if you can get one from #eElma#n.
